priorityList: Apply Instant Poison and maintain Stealth before combat.
Use Adrenaline Rush on cooldown, provided the buff is not already active.
Cast Roll the Bones if no buffs are active or if only one buff is active to fish for better results.
Use Keep It Rolling when you have 2 or more buffs active, ideally when Roll the Bones is on cooldown.
Use finishers (Between the Eyes, Dispatch, Killing Spree) when at 5 or 6 Combo Points.
Maintain Slice and Dice; use Dispatch as a finisher if the buff is missing.
Use Between the Eyes as your priority finisher whenever available.
Cast Killing Spree as a finisher if Between the Eyes is on cooldown.
Cast Coup de Grace as a finisher, or as a builder if Disorienting Strikes is active.
Use Dispatch as your primary spending finisher when other finishers are unavailable.
Use Ambush when the Audacity buff is active or when Hidden Opportunity is talented.
Use Pistol Shot when Opportunity is active, especially at high stacks (Fan the Hammer) or to avoid overcapping Combo Points.
Use Blade Rush if your energy is low to benefit from the energy regeneration.
Use Vanish or Shadowmeld offensively to trigger Ambush (Hidden Opportunity) if no procs are currently active.
Cast Sinister Strike as your primary filler to generate Combo Points.
